detailed_findings.finding: The base case m = 1 is explicitly verified, including the conventions Peak(t) = {1} and U_0(empty) = 1.
The partition S = disjoint union of S_j by the position of the maximal element m is valid and exhaustive.
The relabeling argument on a fixed subset A (and similarly B) correctly preserves comparison signs because the chosen labels are in increasing order.
detailed_findings.location: count of S_j for fixed j in Peak(t)

reason: The proof is a correct and complete combinatorial decomposition by the position of the maximum element m. It handles the base case m=1, partitions counted permutations by the index j where m appears, proves that nonemptiness forces j to be a peak, and for each peak j counts permutations by choosing the left value-set and then relabeling left and right blocks in an order-preserving way to obtain the factors U_{j-1}(t^{<j}) and U_{m-j}(t^{>j}). Boundary conditions and the constraints adjacent to m are checked explicitly. No semantic drift or illegal dependency use is present.
